bio.text: Lincoln Barnett is serving his first term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 63, which covers portions of Crittenden and St. Francis counties.
He previously served as mayor of Hughes from 2019 to 2025 and on the Hughes School District board from 2012 to 2015.
He is a graduate of Morehouse College and holds a Master of Divinity from Memphis Theological Seminary, and he lives in Hughes.
